notes.title: Missing Tales, Finally released
notes.notes:
NSG is 1 year old and, to celebrate, we have a special discount and also our first additional content:


[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/43011680/93b33893d008158796a7615f14e19b4e3c293674.png[/img]

In this new adventure, Hugo and his friends discover that Tales has disappeared and it's up to them to find the bad guy and arrive in time to enjoy the Halloween party with the gang.

Thank you very much for everyone's support and affection. We hope you enjoy this new content.

notes.title: COMING SOON: "Missing Tales", the NSG's first DLC
notes.notes:
Hey guys!

Studio Kraken would like to announce that NSG will receive its first additional content soon, still in 2023.

In [b]Missing Tales[/b], you'll help Hugo, Heloísa and Teodoro discover the whereabouts of their friend Tales, who suddenly disappeared and hasn't shown any signs of life all day. The only clue our esteemed trio has is a mysterious note left by Tales in his school locker.

Now Hugo and his friends will have to search all the city collecting more clues, looking for their friend and finding out what happened to him. And you can help them solve this mystery soon!

Check out more news coming soon on our social networks Twitter, Facebook and Instagram or right here in the Steam Community!

notes.title: NSG: new update - versão 1.1
notes.notes:
Hello,

We have shipped a new update for NSG. Check out the changelog below.

NSG - version 1.1:

[list]
[*] Preparation of the base game to receive the code for the DLC [b]Missing Tales![/b], to be released in 2023;
[*] Cosmetic changes to the game's title screen;
[*] Added link to [b]Missing Tales![/b]'s Steam store page on title screen.
[/list]

Thank you and have fun!
